scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.pages:dev: pnpm --filter @workspace/souq-capital run build && wrangler pages dev artifacts/souq-capital/dist/public
scripts.pages:deploy: pnpm --filter @workspace/souq-capital run build && wrangler pages deploy artifacts/souq-capital/dist/public
